## Checklist

Please confirm all applicable items before requesting a review:

- [ ] CI gate is green: `npm test (Node 22, ubuntu-latest)` / `macos-latest` / `windows-latest` all pass.
- [ ] Tests: new behavior is covered; existing tests updated where behavior changed.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under the appropriate version heading.
- [ ] Multi-language docs synced: `README.md` (English source) and `README.zh.md` / `README.es.md` / `README.pt.md` / `README.hi.md` updated in the same change.
- [ ] Related issue linked (`Fixes #123` / `Closes #123`) when one exists.
- [ ] No secrets: this change contains no tokens, keys, credentials, or real user transcripts.
